You consume a bottle, your cellar informs VINOTAG ® which automatically deducts the bottle in question from your inventory.
More than a simple wine cellar management application, VINOTAG ® is a full-fledged application that allows intelligent and innovative management of your cellar.

Wine cellar management application to keep a precise inventory of your grands crus
A Vinotheque area to register your favorite wines

Share your passion with your loved ones by giving them access to the digital version of your wine cellar
